description: Create an unpaid AIURION checkout link after the customer approves the current quote. This tool does not authorize, charge, or capture a payment and does not place a manufacturing order. Only if the customer later enters payment details and submits Stripe Checkout is their card authorized; AIURION captures payment after model review. The scoped accessToken authenticates only to AIURION, never to Stripe.

accessToken.description: Guest token returned by printing.sessions.start. Optional when Authorization already carries a permanent key or guest token.

approvalConfirmed.description: Set true only after the customer reviews and approves the quote.

fulfillmentMethod.description: How the completed parts should be delivered.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable unique key for retrying checkout creation.

materialId.description: AIURION material identifier listed by printing.capabilities.get. Send this when creating a quote; omission defaults to black_pla. A material change re-slices the model and invalidates the prior price approval.

productionSpeed.description: Requested production priority: standard or rush.

quoteId.description: AIURION quote UUID returned by printing.quotes.create.

name: printing.checkout.create

checkout.description: Stripe Checkout session created for the approved quote.

title: Create Approved Stripe Checkout
